headline: Ukrainian Bank Profits Drop 33% Following 50% Emergency Profit Tax
summary: Net profits across solvent Ukrainian banks fell 33.3% year-on-year to 79.7 billion hryvnias ($1.8 billion) over nine months under a 50% tax rate. Lawmakers are moving to extend the windfall tax through 2027.
why: Ukraine's banking system is undergoing fiscal strains as wartime budget deficits prompt government emergency tax measures.

impacts.name: Ukrainian Banking Sector
impacts.why: A 50% windfall tax rate significantly reduces net banking income and capital buffers.
